title: HELD AIM LET GO ON A FOCUS CHANGE
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: with AIM on HOLD (the default), a right mouse button held when the window lost focus left the aim on after focus came back, so he walked slow and aimed until he right clicked again. The keys, the mouse button, sprint and a held crouch were already let go on a focus change, but not the aim. Proven in headless Chromium: right press on the canvas, window blur and focus, ten frames: still aiming. A held aim is now let go with the keys; AIM on TOGGLE keeps a toggled aim as before.
now: A held aim is let go when the window loses focus, like the other held keys.

edits.anchor: keys={}; try{ HHOLD.arm=0; }catch(_hh){} mouse.down=false; if(G) G.sprinting=false; if(G&&CFG.crouchHold===1) G.crouchTog=false; /* v26.xx (settings2): a held crouch is let go with the keys */ if(G) G.wheel=null; /* v26.xx (wheel2) */
